t.why: Its large lithium reserves draw attention as a source of battery materials.
t.rel: It has been under Western sanctions over land reform and human rights. It depends heavily on the South African economy, and many of its citizens work in South Africa.
t.know: In 2008 it suffered hyperinflation so severe that prices doubled every day.
t.etext: It sells gold, platinum, lithium and tobacco. It has been through severe inflation and currency collapse several times.
